correctness.rationale: Pure subcomplexes are downward closures of largest acyclic Hasse matchings: 256 of size seven for full tetrahedron, 256 of size six for boundary. I independently enumerated all full Hasse matching simplices and these pure downward closures, reproducing four published f-vectors. Exhaustive oriented fixed-simplex signed Lefschetz sums for all five S4 classes yield (-80,2,4,1,0) for each pure complex; for boundary composed with face-complement ghost, (-8,-2,4,1,0). The ghost is a commuting involution on incidences, as in Lin–Scoville. Scoville Theorem 22 confines reduced homology to degree three with rank 81, so L(g)=1-chi3(g) gives S4 character (81,-1,-3,0,1) and ghost row (9,3,-3,0,1). Half-sum/difference gives 45/36 eigenspaces and Specht multiplicities (2,6,3,6,1) and (1,4,3,5,2). The equality of full and boundary S4 modules is rational only.
residual_risks: Finite tetrahedron only; no equivariant homotopy or integral lattice identification.
